_about: Request kinds a delivery request can be (docs/DELIVERY-PIPELINES.md → When no template fits). A pipeline template's `fits.request_kinds` and a skill's `metadata.fits.request_kinds` name these ids; `stages` lists the ADLC stages (shared/adlc-stages.json) a composed pipeline runs for the kind, in order. `stacks` lists the stack ids a `fits.stacks` may name: the signal ids of studio/lib/github/detect.ts plus `any`. Shared with the portal at ingest (studio/data/request-kinds.json).

kinds.description: A new capability on an existing application: defined, planned, built, reviewed, shipped.
A defect on an existing application: built from the request, reviewed, shipped; no product definition or plan approval.
Quality, security, performance or observability work on an existing application: planned, built, reviewed, shipped.
A data-model, platform or dependency migration on an existing application: planned, built, reviewed, shipped.
A new application from a brief: the enterprise skeleton first, then every stage.
Alias of greenfield, as the greenfield-app template names it.

stacks.any: fits every stack (the skill reads nothing stack-specific)
